observations: Activity briefly shows worker records before the generation list loads.
Fully cancelled requests use the generic Finished list summary; cancellation is preserved in job details.
Download ETA varies substantially between files; observed transfer pauses recovered without intervention.
harness_note: Initial video captures caught buffering. Playback wait initially targeted an Activity thumbnail; it was scoped to Media preview and final captures were reviewed again.
